svg.title: Study 23: Between scenes, open interval
svg.desc: At phone width, Ridinger's alert stags appear above Gainsborough's crossing. The sentence between them reads: One image senses an intruder; the other keeps to the crossing. No rules or drawn route join the images.
svg.text: the other keeps to the crossing.
Ridinger, The Met 1974.110 / Gainsborough, The Met 17.120.235
